candidates.reason: Correctly computes signed projects as 80% of the next-year target and preserves the distinction between contracting and revenue. Execution and acceptance are reasonable realization considerations, not asserted completed events or specific contractual facts.

evidence.assessment: The decisive comparison uses the wrong quantity and unit.

candidates.required_action: Correct A to 20 MW and compare required peak power and duration before recommending either battery.

tasks.checked: Requested excerpt reasoning; separated a cross-sectional group difference from a pre/post change and causal effect.

candidates.reason: Preserves the observed faster completion among users while identifying concrete alternative explanations. It does not overcorrect into claiming no useful signal exists.

evidence.excerpt: 10名自愿尝试工具的熟练员工本月任务均耗时40分钟；其他员工均耗时60分钟。没有随机分组、前期数据或同难度任务控制。
evidence.assessment: Selection and skill differ or may differ, and task difficulty is uncontrolled. Neither individual baseline reduction nor causality is identified.

evidence.excerpt: 这是值得进一步对照的信号
evidence.assessment: A useful and proportionate interpretation of the observed association.

candidates.reason: Turns between-group observations into an observed within-group reduction caused by the tool. Restricting geography or organization does not repair internal causal validity. 'Efficiency improvement' also obscures whether the metric is time reduction or throughput.

evidence.excerpt: 工具使员工任务耗时从60分钟降到40分钟
evidence.assessment: No pre-tool time for the volunteers is supplied, and no randomization or equivalent-task control supports this causal change.

evidence.excerpt: 只适用于当前企业，不外推其他行业
evidence.assessment: This external-validity qualifier leaves the unsupported within-company causal inference unchanged.

candidates.required_action: Describe the current group difference, qualify causality and baseline change, and call one third a relative time difference if retaining that number.

evidence.excerpt: entirely inconclusive until all uncertainty is eliminated

evidence.excerpt: statistical precision and persistence remain unresolved
evidence.assessment: Matches the missing variance and long-term data rather than generalizing uncertainty to every conclusion.

scope_limits: Only the specified judge-input.json was read as task/evidence input. No coordinator key, original labels, earlier reviews, other project histories, external sources or author identities were read or sought.
The initial whole-file tool display truncated part of Q07 S1. Its complete supplied text was subsequently read directly from the same packet before judgment; no mandatory packet scope remains unread.

S1/S2 provenance is the packet's stated provenance, not independently authenticated repository state. The repository-relative locators remain source identifiers; sources were not reclassified as adversarial merely because external to this reviewer.

Q01–Q06 are excerpts with no report-length requirement. Q07 is 305 non-whitespace Unicode characters; Q08 is 127 whitespace-separated words, including citations. No unrequested title or report section was required.
The source method documents' mention of other files does not mean those linked files were read. Findings use only the supplied text.

This is targeted revalidation of changed guidance and candidate reasoning on existing tasks, not a randomized efficacy comparison, an estimate of reviewer accuracy, or a claim of general toolkit benefit.
No repository files were edited. Only the requested output JSON was created.
